title: pediomelum megalanthum var. retrorsum
intro: Pediomelum megalanthum var. retrorsum, commonly known as Lomatium, is a flowering plant native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory tract infections and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
